# Golden framebuffer hashes — ENGINE corpus. DO NOT edit by hand.
# Regenerate with: TS_BLESS_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p re_golden --test engine_corpus
# This is the engine/example/archive half of the golden corpus; a host game's
# own campaign story levels are checked against their own separate store.
# See tests/golden/README.md for the corpus split and the campaign sibling.
# Format: key = <shade-sha256> <geom-sha256>, two independent digests per level.
#   shade = row-major {glyph,fg,bg} cells (12 bytes/cell, u32 LE) — the LOOK.
#   geom  = row-major {depth,side,surface,material} (11 bytes/cell) — the CAST.
# A mismatch in shade alone is a shader change; a mismatch in both is a
# raycaster/map/camera change. The split is what makes a red run diagnosable.
